title: Gods reach Lanka and approach Rama
introduction: Gods reach Lanka in aerial cars and approach Rama. They ask Rama why he ignores Seetha, when she is entering into the fire. Rama appeals them to describe in reality who he is. Brahma (the creator) proclaims his divinity and eulogizes him with hymns.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे सप्तदशाधिकश्ततमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 117th chapter in Yuddha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
ततो हि दुर्मना रामः श्रुत्वैवम् वदतां गिरः |
दध्यौ मुहूर्तं धर्मात्मा बाष्पव्याकुललोचनः
verses.iast:
tato hi durmanā rāmaḥ śrutvaivam vadatāṃ giraḥ |
dadhyau muhūrtaṃ dharmātmā bāṣpavyākulalocanaḥ
verses.translation: Hearing the cries of these who were thus wailing, the virtuous minded Rama then became thoughtful for a while, afflicted as he was with melancholy, his eyes filled with tears.

glosses.meaning: afflicted as he was in melancholy

verses.devanagari:
ततो वैश्रवणो राजा यमश्च पृभिः सह |
सहस्राक्षश्च देवेशो वरुणश्च जलेश्वरः
षड्र्धनयनः श्रीमान् महादेवो वृषध्वजः |
कर्ता सर्वस्य लोकस्य ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मविदां वरः
एते सर्वे समागम्य विमानैः सूर्यसंनिभैः |
आगम्य नगरीं लङ्कामभिजग्मुश्च राघवम्
verses.iast:
tato vaiśravaṇo rājā yamaśca pṛbhiḥ saha |
sahasrākṣaśca deveśo varuṇaśca jaleśvaraḥ
ṣaḍrdhanayanaḥ śrīmān mahādevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ |
kartā sarvasya lokasya brahmā brahmavidāṃ varaḥ
ete sarve samāgamya vimānaiḥ sūryasaṃnibhaiḥ |
āgamya nagarīṃ laṇ^kāmabhijagmuśca rāghavam
verses.translation: Thereupon, Kubera the King of Yakshas, Yama the lord of death together with the deceased ancestors, Indra the lord of celestials Varuna the lord of waters, the illustrious Shiva the great deity who bears the device of a bull as his banner and having three eyes, Brahma the creator of all the worlds and the best among the knowers of sacred knowledge all these together reaching the City of Lanka in aerial cars, shining like the sun approached Rama.

glosses.meaning: the illustrious Shiva the great deity
and the best among the knowers of sacred knowledge

verses.devanagari:
ततः सहस्ताभरणान् प्रगृह्य विपुलान् भुजान् |
अब्रुवंस्त्रिदशश्रेष्ठा राघवं प्राञ्जलिं स्थितम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ sahastābharaṇān pragṛhya vipulān bhujān |
abruvaṃstridaśaśreṣṭhā rāghavaṃ prāJṇjaliṃ sthitam
verses.translation: Lifting their long arms, their hands decked with ornaments, those excellent gods thereupon, spoke (as follows) to Rama who stood there, making a respectful salutation to them with his folded hands.

glosses.meaning: their hands decked with ornaments (as follows)
making a respectful salutation with folded hands.

verses.devanagari:
कर्ता सर्वस्य लोकस्य श्रेष्ठो ज्ञानवतां प्रभुः |
उपेक्षसे कथं सीतां पतन्तीं हव्यवाहने
कथं देवगणश्रेष्ठमात्मानं नावबुद्ध्यसे |
verses.iast:
kartā sarvasya lokasya śreṣṭho jJṇānavatāṃ prabhuḥ |
upekṣase kathaṃ sītāṃ patantīṃ havyavāhane
kathaṃ devagaṇaśreṣṭhamātmānaṃ nāvabuddhyase |
verses.translation: "How do you, the maker of the entire cosmos, the foremost among those endowed with knowledge and an all-capable person, ignore Seetha who is falling into the fire? How do you not recognize yourself to be the foremost of the troop of gods?"

glosses.meaning: (you) who are the maker of the entire cosmons
and the foremost among those endowed with knowledge
as the foremost among the troop of gods.

verses.devanagari:
ऋतधामा वसुः पूर्वं वसूनां च प्रजापतिः
त्रयाणामपि लोकानामादिकर्ता स्वयं प्रभुः |
verses.iast:
ṛtadhāmā vasuḥ pūrvaṃ vasūnāṃ ca prajāpatiḥ
trayāṇāmapi lokānāmādikartā svayaṃ prabhuḥ |
verses.translation: "Among the Vasus (a class of gods, eight in number), you are the Vasu, named R^itadhama (one whose abode is Truth or the Divine Law) who was formerly the self-constituted ruler, the first creator of all the three worlds and the lord of creatures."

glosses.meaning: among the Vasus (a class of gods
R^itadhaama (one whose abode is Truth or the Divine law)
lokaanaam = of all the three worlds

verses.devanagari:
रुद्राणामष्टमो रुद्रः साध्यानामपि पञ्चमः
अश्विनौ चापि कर्णौ ते सूर्याचन्द्रामसौ दृशौ |
verses.iast:
rudrāṇāmaṣṭamo rudraḥ sādhyānāmapi paJṇcamaḥ
aśvinau cāpi karṇau te sūryācandrāmasau dṛśau |
verses.translation: "You are the eighth Rudra among (eleven) Rudras and the fifth (Viryavan by name) among the Sadhyas (a particular class of celestials belonging to Gana Devata). The twin Aswinis are your ears. The sun and the moon constitute your eyes."

glosses.meaning: and the fifth (viryavaan by name) saadhyaanaam api = among the Sadhyas (a particular class of celestial beings belonging to Gana Devata)
the twin = Aswinis (the physicians of gods)

verses.devanagari:
अन्ते चादौ च लोकानां दृश्यसे च परंतप
उपेक्षसे च वैदेहीं मानुषः प्राकृतो यथा |
verses.iast:
ante cādau ca lokānāṃ dṛśyase ca parantapa
upekṣase ca vaidehīṃ mānuṣaḥ prākṛto yathā |
verses.translation: "O the destroyer of the adversaries. You are seen (to exist) at the beginning and at the end of creation. Yet, you ignore Seetha, just like a common man."

verses.devanagari:
इत्युक्तो लोकपालैस्तैः स्वामी लोकस्य राघवः
अब्रवित्त्रिदशश्रेष्ठान् रामो धर्मभृतां वरः |
verses.iast:
ityukto lokapālaistaiḥ svāmī lokasya rāghavaḥ
abravittridaśaśreṣṭhān rāmo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ |
verses.translation: Hearing the words of those guardians of the world, Rama, the lord of creation, who was born in Raghu dynasty and the foremost one among protectors of righteousness, spoke to those god-chiefs as follows:

glosses.meaning: who was born in Raghu dynasty
and the foremost one among the protectors of righteousness

verses.devanagari:
आत्मानं मानुषं मन्ये रामं दशरथात्मजम्
सोऽहं यस्य यतश्चाहं भगवंस्तद्ब्रवीतु मे |
verses.iast:
ātmānaṃ mānuṣaṃ manye rāmaṃ daśarathātmajam
so'haṃ yasya yataścāhaṃ bhagavaṃstadbravītu me |
verses.translation: "I think of myself to be a human being, by name Rama, the son of Dasaratha. You, as a gracious Divinity, tell me that which I as such really am like this."

glosses.meaning: which I as such really am
and why I am like this.

verses.devanagari:
इति ब्रुवाणं काकुत्थ्सं ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मविदां वरः
अब्रवीच्छृणु मे वाक्यं सत्यं सत्यपराक्रम |
verses.iast:
iti bruvāṇaṃ kākutthsaṃ brahmā brahmavidāṃ varaḥ
abravīcchṛṇu me vākyaṃ satyaṃ satyaparākrama |
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Rama, Brahma (the creator), the foremost among the knowers of Brahma the Absolute, spoke as follows: "Listen to my true word, O the truly brave lord!"

glosses.meaning: among the knowers of Brahma the Absolute

verses.devanagari:
भवान्नारायणो देवः श्रीमांश्चक्रायुधः प्रभुः
एकशृङ्गो वराहस्त्वं भूतभव्यसपत्नजित् |
verses.iast:
bhavānnārāyaṇo devaḥ śrīmāṃścakrāyudhaḥ prabhuḥ
ekaśṛṇ^go varāhastvaṃ bhūtabhavyasapatnajit |
verses.translation: "You are the Lord Narayana himself the glorious god, who wields the discus. You are the Divine Boar with a single tusk, the conqueror of your past and future enemies."

glosses.meaning: the conqueror of your past and future enemies.

verses.devanagari:
अक्षरं ब्रह्म सत्यं च मध्ये चान्ते च राघव
लोकानां त्वं परो धर्मो विष्वक्सेनश्चतुर्भजः |
verses.iast:
akṣaraṃ brahma satyaṃ ca madhye cānte ca rāghava
lokānāṃ tvaṃ paro dharmo viṣvaksenaścaturbhajaḥ |
verses.translation: "You are Brahma, the imperishable, the Truth abiding in the middle as well as at the end of the universe. You are the supreme righteousness of people, whose powers go everywhere. You are the four-armed."

glosses.meaning: in the Middle and at the end
you are paraH dharmaH = the Supreme righteousness

verses.devanagari:
शार्ङ्गधन्वा हृषीकेशः पुरुषः पुरुषोत्तमः
अजितः खड्गधृग्विष्णुः कृष्णश्चैव महाबलः |
verses.iast:
śārṇ^gadhanvā hṛṣīkeśaḥ puruṣaḥ puruṣottamaḥ
ajitaḥ khaḍgadhṛgviṣṇuḥ kṛṣṇaścaiva mahābalaḥ |
verses.translation: "You are the wielder of a bow called Sarnga, the lord of the senses, the supreme soul of the universe, the best of men, the invincible, the wielder of a sword named Nandaka, the all-pervader, the bestower of happiness to the earth and endowed with great might."

glosses.meaning: you are the wielder of a bow
the supreme soul of the universe
the wielder of a sword named Nandaka
the bestower of happiness to the earth

verses.devanagari:
सेनानीर्ग्रामणीश्च त्वं त्वं बुद्धि स्त्वं क्षमा दमः
प्रभवश्चाप्ययश्च त्वमुपेन्द्रो मधुसूदनः |
verses.iast:
senānīrgrāmaṇīśca tvaṃ tvaṃ buddhi stvaṃ kṣamā damaḥ
prabhavaścāpyayaśca tvamupendro madhusūdanaḥ |
verses.translation: "You are the leader of the army and the village headman. You are the intellect. You are the endurance and the subduer of the senses. You are the origin and the dissolution of all, Upendra the Divine Dwarf and (the younger brother of Indra) as also the destroyer Madhu, the demon."

glosses.meaning: are the leader of the army
the Divine Dwarf (the younger brother of Indra)

verses.devanagari:
इन्द्रकर्मा महेन्द्रस्त्वं पद्मनाभो रणान्तकृत्
शरण्यं शरणम् च त्वामहुर्दिव्या महर्षयः |
verses.iast:
indrakarmā mahendrastvaṃ padmanābho raṇāntakṛt
śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇam ca tvāmahurdivyā maharṣayaḥ |
verses.translation: "You perform action for Indra the lord of celestials, the Supreme Ruler, the one having a lotus in one's navel and who puts an end to all in battle. The divine sages pronounce you to be fit to afford protection to all and the refuge for all."

glosses.meaning: perform action for Indra the lord of celestials
and the one having a lotus in one's navel
and who puts an end to all in battle
to be fit to afford protection toa ll

verses.devanagari:
सहस्रशृङ्गो वेदात्मा शतशीर्षो महर्षभः
त्वं त्रयाणां हि लोकानामादिकर्ता स्वयंप्रभुः |
सिद्धानामपि साध्यानामाश्रयश्चासि पूर्वजः
verses.iast:
sahasraśṛṇ^go vedātmā śataśīrṣo maharṣabhaḥ
tvaṃ trayāṇāṃ hi lokānāmādikartā svayamprabhuḥ |
siddhānāmapi sādhyānāmāśrayaścāsi pūrvajaḥ
verses.translation: "In the form of the Vedas, you are the great Bull with hundred heads (rules) and thousand horns (precepts). You are the first creator of all, the three worlds, and the self constituted Lord of all. You are the refuge and the forbear of Siddhas (a class of demi-gods endowed with mystic powers by virtue of their very birth) and Sadhyas (a class of celestial beings.)"

glosses.meaning: In the form of the Vedas
are the first creator of all
the self constituted Lord of all
of Siddhas (a class of demi-gods endowed with mystic powers by virtue of their very birth) and Sadhyas (a class of celestial beings).

verses.devanagari:
त्वं यज्ञ्स्त्वं वषट्कारस्त्वमोंकारः परात्परः
प्रभवं निधनं वा ते नो विदुः को भवानिति |
verses.iast:
tvaṃ yajJṇstvaṃ vaṣaṭkārastvamoṅkāraḥ parātparaḥ
prabhavaṃ nidhanaṃ vā te no viduḥ ko bhavāniti |
verses.translation: "You are the sacrificial performance. You are the sacred syllable 'Vashat' (on hearing which the Adhvaryu priest casts the oblation to a deity into the sacrificial fire). You are the mystic syllable 'OM'. You are higher than the highest. People neither know your end nor your origin nor who you are in reality."

glosses.meaning: are the sacred syllable 'Vasat' (on hearing which the Adhvaryu priest casts the oblation to a deity into the sacrificial fire)
nor who you are in reality.

verses.devanagari:
दृश्यसे सर्वभूतेषु गोषु च ब्राह्मणेषु च
दिक्षु सर्वासु गगने पर्वतेषु नदीषु च |
verses.iast:
dṛśyase sarvabhūteṣu goṣu ca brāhmaṇeṣu ca
dikṣu sarvāsu gagane parvateṣu nadīṣu ca |
verses.translation: "You appear in all created beings in the cattle and in brahmanas. You exist in all quarters, in the sky, in mountains and in rivers."

verses.devanagari:
सहस्रचरणः श्रीमान् शतशीर्षः सहस्रदृक्
त्वं धारयसि भूतानि पृथिवीं च सपर्वताम् |
verses.iast:
sahasracaraṇaḥ śrīmān śataśīrṣaḥ sahasradṛk
tvaṃ dhārayasi bhūtāni pṛthivīṃ ca saparvatām |
verses.translation: "With thousand feet, with hundred heads and with thousand eyes along with Lakshmi the goddess of wealth, you bear the earth with all its created beings along with its mountains."

glosses.meaning: along with Lakshmi the goddess of wealth

verses.devanagari:
अन्ते पृथिव्याः सलिले दृश्यसे त्वं महोरगः
त्रीन् लोकान् धारयन् राम देवगन्धर्वदानवान् |
verses.iast:
ante pṛthivyāḥ salile dṛśyase tvaṃ mahoragaḥ
trīn lokān dhārayan rāma devagandharvadānavān |
verses.translation: "O Rama! You appear as Sesha, a large serpent in water, at the earth's bottom, bearing the three worlds, gods, Gandharvas, the celestial musicians and the demons."

verses.devanagari:
अहं ते हृदयं राम जिह्वा देवी सरस्वती
देवा रोमाणि गात्रेषु ब्रह्मणा निर्मिताः प्रभो |
verses.iast:
ahaṃ te hṛdayaṃ rāma jihvā devī sarasvatī
devā romāṇi gātreṣu brahmaṇā nirmitāḥ prabho |
verses.translation: "O Rama! I (brahma) am your heart. Saraswathi, the goddess (of learning) is your tongue. O lord! The gods created by Brahma are the hair on all your limbs."

verses.devanagari:
निमेषस्ते स्मृता रात्रिरुन्मेषो दिवसस्तथा
संस्कारास्त्वभवन्वेदा नैतदस्ति त्वया विना |
verses.iast:
nimeṣaste smṛtā rātrirunmeṣo divasastathā
saṃskārāstvabhavanvedā naitadasti tvayā vinā |
verses.translation: "Night has been recognized as the closing of your eye-lids and the day, as the opening of eye-lids. The correct usages of your words are the Vedas. Bereft of you, this visible universe does not exist."

glosses.meaning: as the closing of your eye-lids
as the opening of your eye-lids
the correct usages of your words

verses.devanagari:
जगत्सर्वं शरीरं ते स्थैर्यं ते वसुधातलम्
अग्निः कोपः प्रसादस्ते सोमः श्रीवत्सलक्षणः |
verses.iast:
jagatsarvaṃ śarīraṃ te sthairyaṃ te vasudhātalam
agniḥ kopaḥ prasādaste somaḥ śrīvatsalakṣaṇaḥ |
verses.translation: "The entire cosmos is your body. The earth constitutes your firmness. Fire is your anger. The moon constitutes your placidity. You are Lord Vishnu (who bears the mark Srivatsa - a curl of white hair on his breast)."

glosses.meaning: the moon (constitutes) te prasaadaH = your placidity
you are Lord Vishnu (who bears the mark Srivatsa = a curl of white hair on his breast).

verses.devanagari:
त्वया लोकास्त्रयः क्रान्ताः पुरा स्वैर्विक्रमैस्त्रिभिः
महेन्द्रश्च कृतो राजा बलिं बद्ध्वा सुदारुणम् |
verses.iast:
tvayā lokāstrayaḥ krāntāḥ purā svairvikramaistribhiḥ
mahendraśca kṛto rājā baliṃ baddhvā sudāruṇam |
verses.translation: "In the past, the three worlds were occupied by you in your three strides, after binding the exceptionally formidable Bali (the ruler of the three worlds) and Indra was made the king (by you)."

verses.devanagari:
सीता लक्ष्मीर्भवान् विष्णुर्देवः कृष्णः प्रजापतिः
वधार्थं रावणस्येह प्रविष्टो मानुषीं तनुम् |
verses.iast:
sītā lakṣmīrbhavān viṣṇurdevaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prajāpatiḥ
vadhārthaṃ rāvaṇasyeha praviṣṭo mānuṣīṃ tanum |
verses.translation: "Seetha is no other than Goddess Lakshmi (the divine consort of Lord Vishnu), while you are Lord Vishnu. You are having a shining dark-blue hue. You are the Lord of created beings. For the destruction of Ravana, you entered a human body here, on this earth."

glosses.meaning: is (no other than) Goddess Lakshmi (the divine consort of Lord Vishnu)
are having a dark blue hue
you are the Lord of created beings

verses.devanagari:
तदिदं नस्त्वया कार्यं कृतं धर्मभृतां वर
निहतो रावणो राम प्रहृष्टो दिवमाक्रम |
verses.iast:
tadidaṃ nastvayā kāryaṃ kṛtaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ vara
nihato rāvaṇo rāma prahṛṣṭo divamākrama |
verses.translation: "O Rama, the foremost among the supporters of righteousness! The aforesaid purpose of ours has been fulfilled. Ravana has been killed. Return to your divine abode, with a rejoice."

verses.devanagari:
अमोघं देव वीर्यं ते न ते मोघाः पराक्रमाः
अमोघं दर्शनं राम अमोघस्तव संस्तवः |
verses.iast:
amoghaṃ deva vīryaṃ te na te moghāḥ parākramāḥ
amoghaṃ darśanaṃ rāma amoghastava saṃstavaḥ |
verses.translation: "O Lord! Unerring is your valour. Your exploits are never in vain. O Rama! Your blessed sight is powerful. The songs in praise of you never go in vain."

verses.devanagari:
अमोघास्ते भविष्यन्ति भक्तिमन्तो नरा भुवि
ये त्वां देवम् ध्रुवं भक्ताः पुराणं पुरुषोत्तमम् |
प्राप्नुवन्ति सदा कामानिह लोके पात्र च
verses.iast:
amoghāste bhaviṣyanti bhaktimanto narā bhuvi
ye tvāṃ devam dhruvaṃ bhaktāḥ purāṇaṃ puruṣottamam |
prāpnuvanti sadā kāmāniha loke pātra ca
verses.translation: "Those humans who are full of devotion to you will never be unsuccessful on this earth. Those who are devoted to you, the primeval and the eternal lord, belonging to ancient times and the Supreme Person, will forever attain their desired objects here as well as hereafter."

glosses.meaning: will forever attain kaamaam = their desired objects

verses.devanagari:
इममार्षम् स्तवं दिव्यमितिहासं पुरातनम्
ये नराः कीर्तयिष्यन्ति नास्ति तेषां पराभवः |
verses.iast:
imamārṣam stavaṃ divyamitihāsaṃ purātanam
ye narāḥ kīrtayiṣyanti nāsti teṣāṃ parābhavaḥ |
verses.translation: "Humiliation will never be the plight of those humans who will recite this hymn in a divine ancient history, sung by Brahma, the foremost seer."
